_about: Mono (working name; studied from 'Phantasic AI training #3', see engine/templates/mono.md): every phrase is a statement page. Footage in its original colour (Ahmed, 30 Sep: not grey; the reference was grayscale, set brand.film + look.grade to get that back), a deep accent (forest green by default) and white pages that flip on the beat, a three-tier type stack (small lead / HUGE heavy key / small italic tail), engraving icons and brand logos above the key, the speaker in a rounded card or a phone with a reels UI. No running captions: the pages ARE the captions.

director.style: A statement edit. The whole video is a chain of stack pages, one per phrase (0.7-2 s), cut hard into each other. About 40% of the time the ground is the speaker's own grayscale footage (bg footage), the rest is accent/paper pages, a footage card (bg card) or a phone (bg phone).
director.stack: {type:scene, kind:stack, at, to, bg: accent|paper|footage|card|phone, lead: the small words spoken before the key, key: ONE word (or two short) spoken as the punch, drawn huge, keySay: the spoken form if key is censored or re-cased, tail: the small italic words spoken right after, icon: engraving name (brain, coins, gears, team, rocket, chart, target...), logo: simple-icons slug when a platform/product is NAMED (youtube, instagram), logoFill: its brand colour, flips: [source seconds] where an accent/paper page inverts (1-2 per page, on lead and on key)}. Every word on a page must be spoken while it is up.
director.rhythm: Never two of the same ground in a row. Pattern from the reference: footage -> page(flips, icon) -> card -> footage -> phone -> page(flips) -> footage(icon) -> page(flips, icon) -> footage -> phone(logos).
director.automatic: Grayscale grade, sounds on keys and icons, quiet bed.
